name: Aim Assist Switchboard
description: Quickly enable or disable the built-in aim assistance.
author: Tavros Baker
code: const remove=xlinkWorkshop.addCheat("Aim Assist Switchboard","Quickly enable or disable the built-in aim assistance.",async()=>{const choice=prompt('Enter on or off for Aim Assist Switchboard','on');if(!choice)return;if(!['on','off'].includes(choice.toLowerCase()))throw Error('Choose on or off');await xlink.command("cheat aim"+' '+choice.toLowerCase())});return remove;
